items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we listened to all those French records with Django Reinhardt and the great artists there

ctx.x: Your love and passion for the music actually became a social phenomenon. You created, along with some of your friends, a Hot Club. Can you talk about forming the Hot Club?

Right! The Hot Club of Newark. You see, it wasn’t just a passing fad. My brother could have introduced me, and I could have gone in another direction. But I was there for the whole thing. We took the name, The Newark Hot Club, because in France they had the Hot Club of France, and we listened to all those French records with Django Reinhardt and the great artists there—and that became our name, the Hot Club of Newark.
